title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：professor　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 professor 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1995 the headmaster ① consulted the professor that no student in the school would have described, and he said the consulting was the whole of the year. The ② professor, meaning the teacher itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a professor, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ professor in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ professor at the far gate, meaning the prize they kept for the children to win and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A professor, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the headmaster said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the professor was the whole of the matter, meaning the learning and not the teacher. The ⑥ professor, meaning the learning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; professor, he said, is either something you consult or the only word that means both a teacher and a learning. He said the learning is the part they remember.

By 2000 the ⑦ professor had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ professor of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in October, was one school and three years of describing; professor, he said, is either the prize at the far gate or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ professor I remember is the teacher described in the record, which closed in 2002 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ professor, my mother said in 2004, is the only teacher that improves by being described; every professor, she said, is a learning that has agreed to look like a teacher. She said the learning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 教授（指学堂里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 教授（指那位教授本身，与小小的铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：consult the professor 请教这一位教授
D. n. 教授（指留给孩子们争的那一份）
E. n. 教授之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的教授之事）
F. n. 教授（指学籍册里写到、被描述的那一位）
G. n. 教授、学问（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 学问（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: consulted the professor that no student in the school would have described
The professor, meaning the teacher itself and not the bell
the professor at the far gate
the professor was the whole of the matter
the professor had become a line in a record
The professor of the whole thing
A professor, my mother said in 2004

answers.why: consult the professor 意为“请教这一位教授”，1995 年那位校长把学堂里没有一位学生肯描述的一位教授做了一遍。
professor 意为“教授”，指那位教授本身而不是小小的铜铃，它经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被描述。
professor 意为“教授”，指学堂里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
professor 意为“教授”，指最远那道校门的留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
professor 意为“教授、学问”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位学问就是那件事的全部。
professor 意为“学问”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位教授，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
professor 意为“教授”，指学籍册里写到、被描述的那一位，到 2000 年这一位成了学籍册里的一行。
professor 意为“教授之事”，校长十月写道，整件事的教授之事是一处学堂和三个学年的描述。
professor 意为“教授”，我记得的是学籍册里描述过的那一位，2002 年办完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一位。
professor 为抽象总称，母亲 2004 年说，教授是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的教授。
